The reference anchor is Quanta Services, whose scale and electric backlog make it the benchmark for grid construction capacity. The underfollowed lane is strongest in MYR Group and Primoris, both mid-cap public contractors with direct transmission, distribution, utility, power-delivery, or infrastructure-services exposure. MasTec is included as a larger but still relevant diversified infrastructure platform with explicit Power Delivery and Clean Energy backlog exposure. This pass stays focused on direct asset owners, product leaders, platforms, direct customers, and obvious leaders; upstream hardware suppliers such as PLPC are noted only as evidence context for later layers. Expanded the EPC/grid-services node using a two-lane funnel. Quanta remains the reference benchmark for craft-labor, transmission, renewables, and large-load execution capacity. The underfollowed lane is more interesting in smaller public contractors with utility/power-delivery backlogs, plus one second-order hardware supplier whose order intake may precede field construction. This is research support only, not a buy/sell recommendation.
